multiply-values-variable.basis: 2 and -3 are each multiplied by 4, 0 and a duplicate 4 in Cartesian order.

unique-components-variable.basis: Flatten [b,a,b] then [c,a] and retain the first occurrence of each distinct string.

split-parts-variable.basis: Literal :: delimiters preserve the leading, adjacent and trailing empty segments of ::a::::. The absent delimiter leaves plain intact.

concat-cartesian-variable.basis: Both two-value components contribute to the ordered Cartesian product.

substring-minimum-start-variable.basis: The lowest signed 32-bit start is treated as position one by the source rule.

substring-negative-length-variable.basis: Starting at position four with negative length selects the remainder.

substring-maximum-length-variable.basis: Length above the remaining text selects the remainder from position four.

substring-zero-length-variable.basis: Starting at position two of abc and including zero characters yields a present empty string.

first-and-empty-capture-variable.basis: Use the first capture of the first match. No match and an empty capture each produce a present empty string.

no-capture-group-variable.basis: A successful text match without a capture group yields an empty string.

exceptional_expression.basis: Start position 4 exceeds the three-character source. The inherited substring rule reports an error.
